subject: Post-call: SkyBridge security discovery & evidence path (SOC 2 / retention / pen test)
thread_body:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@skybridgecap.com>, Linda Huang <lhuang@skybridgecap.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: SkyBridge security discovery & evidence path (SOC 2 / retention / pen test)

Hi Daniel / Linda —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we have a single source of truth: I focused the notes on the compliance items you flagged (SOC 2, audit logging/retention, DPA redlines, and pen test evidence). Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of pain / goals
- Regulatory pressure: you need demonstrable controls for investor reporting and for an upcoming integration with a strategic banking partner.
- Audit readiness: SkyBridge requires proof of SOC 2 or equivalent controls; you want to understand whether Redwood’s SOC 2 report + artifact set will satisfy your internal auditors.
- Audit logs & retention: required retention is 7 years for transaction audit trails (banking partner requirement). You asked whether we can provide immutable export of audit logs and the retention policy.
- Data processing agreement (DPA): you’ve got a few redlines around subprocessor notification windows and data deletion timelines.
- Pen test evidence: you need post-pen-test remediation summary and a redacted report (sensitive sections removed).

What we can provide (short answer)
- SOC 2 Type II executive summary + control mappings to common DDQ questions (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
- Audit log exports via CSV/Parquet with tamper-evident checksums; retention configurable up to 10 years for Dedicated/Private customers.
- DPA redline we can accept most redlines; see attached redline (redwood-dpa-redline.docx).
- Pen test: we can provide a redacted report and remediation timeline; full unredacted reports are available under an NDA for strategic partners.

Concrete asks / action items (owners & suggested timelines)
1) SkyBridge: confirm the precise list of audit log fields you need exported (transaction_id, timestamp, user_id, request_path, model_id, token_counts, and response_hash). -> Daniel to confirm by 2028-03-15.
2) Redwood: deliver SOC 2 executive summary + control mapping and a populated DDQ template. -> Irene to send attachments by 2028-03-13. (attached: ddq-template filled subset: sb-ddq-template-filled.pdf)
3) SkyBridge: review DPA redline and highlight any remaining non-starters. -> Linda to return comments by 2028-03-20.
4) Redwood Security: prepare redacted pen test summary and remediation timeline for sharing; if SkyBridge needs the unredacted report, we’ll run an NDA checklist. -> Karthik / Security to share by 2028-03-16.
5) Joint: schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security ops to walk through the audit-log export format and retention controls. -> Proposed slot: 2028-03-18 16:00 UTC.

Attachments included with this message:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (executive summary + control mapping)
- sb-ddq-template-filled.pdf (DDQ excerpt you can review)
- redwood-dpa-redline.docx (our suggested redline)

Next steps from my side: I’ll attach the mapping doc and the DDQ subset in a separate email (small file) and enable a shared drive folder for the audit-log export schema so we can iterate.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Lead, Compliance & Security
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

--- Original Message ---
From: Daniel Park <dpark@skybridgecap.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Linda Huang <lhuang@skybridgecap.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 14:10:24 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up

Thanks for the detailed walk — helpful. A few clarifications from our side:
- The 7-year retention is non-negotiable from our partner.
- For audit logs we also need signed checksums (to show integrity over time). Can Redwood provide a time-stamped signature?
- For SOC 2 we need the mapping to our internal DDQ matrix (I saw the attachment name — that will help).

We’ll take a look at the DPA redline but expect two asks: (1) faster subprocessor notification windows, and (2) a 30–45 day deletion window for deletion requests in the most recent data (longer archival retention exceptions are understood).

I’ll get our security ops on the thread if we need deeper technical detail.

Daniel
Head of Integrations
SkyBridge Capital

> On Mar 12, 2028, at 13:05, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
>
> Irene / Daniel — good intro. I captured the technical bits in my notes: export format is fine with token_count and model_id; we will include a signed SHA-256 per-file checksum and timestamp. For the 7-year retention ask, I want to flag that this is possible on Dedicated/Private but for Hosted customers we need contract/archival add-on.
>
> Karthik and I will validate the pen test sharing flow; we typically provide a redacted report and offer an NDA process for the full artifact.
>
> M
>
> --
> Marissa Cole
> Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
> marissa_cole@redwood.com
